notes.title: Small Change to Time Mode
notes.notes:
Due to the overwhelming advantage that the "Rock Hard Stamp" grants compared to other stamps, a balance change was necessary to keep leaderboard competition as fair as possible.

CHANGES:

-Rock Hard Stamp will no longer drop in Time Mode.
-Rock Hard Stamp is now applied automatically to all runs. This change will remain until update 0.8.
From update 0.8, stamps will see additional changes in Time Mode only.

Unless further major bugs or issues are found and need to be fixed immediately, we will now primarily focus on developing the next major content update. This means there will be no more small patches until then.

We will likely share more about the next content update (0.8) in the later half of this year.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: New Tech

Thanks to new advanced technology, we can now render images in text!

Updates and bug fixes will likely pause for a while. Further development will slow down for the time being as holidays are coming up and the team needs a serious break. We hope you can understand!

notes.title: It's Time to Stop Being Too Greedy
notes.notes:
Another update!

More various balance changes and bug fixes.

This is something we really wanted to avoid nerfing as much as possible because we know it's fun, but unfortunately the greed has gone out of control, and it is finally time to nerf the stamp a little bit. We know people will be upset by it, but we think it will be for the better in the future. Sorry ):
  
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

[b]SHIROGANE NOEL[/b]

Gyudon's ATK bonus now requires 20 HP instead of 10 per increase of ATK.
In a previous build, Noel's Gyudon skill description text was corrected to +3 HP instead of +5 HP. 
Since the launch of 0.7, this skill has always given +3 HP, not +5 HP.

notes.title: Free Vampire Survivors rival Holocure explodes on Steam with packed new update
notes.notes:
Vampire Survivors wasn't the first to attempt the 'bullet heaven' style of high-speed roguelike survival games, but it certainly became the most prominent. One of its strongest contenders, however, is Holocure Save the Fans, a free Steam game created by Kay 'KayAnimate' Yu as a fan project based on the Hololive vtuber agency. An extremely well put-together project that adapts the roguelike format to the universe of anime-avatar YouTube streamers, it's already racked up an incredible 99% Steam user rating from almost 32,000 reviews. Now, as a huge update lands, players are flooding back to play it en masse.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Update 0.7 Released!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

It has been a long time and we apologize for the wait, but update 0.7 has been released!

We hope you all continue to enjoy the game and all the things this update has to offer!

CHANGES:---------------

GENERAL

-9 new characters has been added.
-New weapons and collabs have been added.
-New items have been added.
-New stamps have been added.
-New shop items have been added.
-New Normal stage and new Hard Stage has been added.
-New areas in Holo House has been unlocked.
-Usada Casino is now open! Several minigames have been added.
-New gathering materials have been added.
-A new action button has been added.
-New "Prism" system has been added.
-Fan Letter system has been added.
-Several menus revamped.
-Change to Critical stat. If Critical is beyond 100%, each additional 1% Crit grants 0.5% additional damage.
-Random select in character select can now be activated with the new third action button.
-Food system is overhauled, can now store all kinds of Food created, and can also stockpile each type of food. Food is now selected at the Preparation Screen.
-Items can now be upgraded to its Super version at a small chance from Holozon boxes. If a box is a Super Item box, there is a chance that it will upgrade a currently held item to its super version instead of a new Super Item.
-Leaderboard is closed until a later update.


-CHARACTERS-

AZKi
-Character has been revamped.
-Special has been changed.
-Skills have been changed. Virtual Diva has been changed to Virtual Saber, and Performance has been changed to Geographer.

AME
-Skill name of FPS Mastery has been changed to "The Ame Way". EFfect has also been adjusted.
 Note: Previously, FPS Mastery's text stated "All weapons deal 15% more damage", when in reality it increased ATK by 15%.
 The text has been corrected, and this effect is unchanged.

ANYA
-Cutting Deep has been replaced with Debugger with an adjusted effect.

AKI
-Aromatherapy now can also stun targets as an added effect.
-Damage of Mukirose has been increased slightly.
-New effect has been added to Belly Dancing.

BAE
-Skill name of "CRATical Hit" has been changed to "Rat's Ninja Way". Skill icon has been changed.
-Skill name of "RatNG" has been changed to "Harbinger of Chaos".
-Skill effect has been adjusted and a new effect has been added to "Harbinger of Chaos".

MATSURI
-Bonus buff for perfecting the Taiko Drum sequence has been extended by 5 seconds. Bonus buffs also increased slightly.
-Damage for Fireworks from perfecting the Taiko Drum sequence has been increased.
-(Further changes later)

SHION
-Damage of Special attack is increased from 1000% to 1500%.

OKAYU
-Duration of Mogu Mogu is increased from 6 to 7 seconds, and SPD buff is increased from 50% to 75%.

FUBUKI
-Reduced the size of Kon Kon attacks but also increased damage very slightly.

AQUA
-Increased damage of NEKO.
-Changed skill name and icon of Klutz. Effect has also been adjusted.

ZETA
-Cat? Reflexes skill adjusted. Now grants stacks that turn on Silent Pistol's Stealth mode without being invisible.
-Cat? Reflexes crit buff has been increased.

MEL
-Acerola Juice now only adds Life Steal on the main weapon. Amount of life steal is increased.

CHOCO
-Nurse now requires a heal of 12 HP or more to activate, instead of critical heal as the activation requirement.

-WEAPONS-

FAN BEAM
-No longer horizontal only (finally).

-ITEMS-

DEVIL HAT
-Effect has been changed. Effect now activates upon using Special.

GWS Pill
-Additional effect has been added. GWS Pill now also increases the damage of all Skill attacks.

-FOOD-

VEGETABLE SOUP
-Effect has been changed.

-COLLAB-

Jingiskan
-Heal has been slightly reduced.

I'm Die, Thank You Forever
-No longer creates multiple explosions when one target has taken multiple bombs. Instead, will only create 1 explosion with damage that is adjusted based on how many bombs were attached (for optimization and reducing slow downs).
  e.g. Before: 10 bombs attached to boss, it creates 10 explosions at once when defeated
       Now: 10 bombs attached to boss, it creates 1 explosion that is equivalent to 10x damage when defeated


-STAMPS-

-The damage penalty on the main weapon has been reduced.

Reverse Stamp
-Effect has been changed.

notes.title: Hotfix 8/23
notes.notes:
Fixing some more bugs and crashes innit

-Fixed not loading backup saves properly and game crashing if data is corrupted. Previously, the backup file was not being loaded properly, leading to a crash.
[list]
[*] If your save has been corrupted, the backup save will try to be loaded
[*] If your save AND your backup save is corrupt, the game will start from the beginning.
[*] If your settings file is corrupt, settings will reset to default.
[/list]
